operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Israeli Strike Kills Palestinian Doctor in Gaza as Conflict Enters Day 962
heroSubtitle: On Day 961 (May 29, 2026), Netanyahu announced his directive for the IDF to extend Israeli territorial control from 60% to 70% of the Gaza Strip, drawing immediate concern from Germany and the UN. Continued strikes killed at least 6 more Palestinians. On Day 960 (May 28): an IDF strike on a Gaza City residential building killed 10 people including 4 children and wounded 20+; Hamas Gaza City Brigade deputy commander Imad Aslim was killed. The US reinstated sanctions on UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese. On Day 959 (May 27 / Eid al-Adha): Hamas confirmed Mohammed Odeh's death — the 4th Qassam Brigades chief killed since Oct 7, eliminated just 11 days after predecessor al-Haddad. UN agencies report 470,000 Gazans face catastrophic (IPC Phase 5) hunger through September 2026, ceasefire Phase II talks are deadlocked, and the $4.1B Flash Appeal remains only 12% funded.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Haaretz, IMEMC, WAFA, WFP, CBS News, Washington Post, Palestine Chronicle, UN News.
